role: Applies multiplicative confidence decay to active INSTANCE-level knowledge graph nodes, closing nodes that fall below a confidence threshold.
detail: Implements CANON A.10 confidence decay for co-being knowledge graph. Exports DecayResult (dataclass with nodes_decayed, nodes_closed, nodes_skipped counts) and run_confidence_decay (async coroutine). Only decays INSTANCE nodes with valid_to=None (active). Uses last_confirmed or created_at as reference time for age calculation. Applies decay_factor multiplicatively to confidence; closes nodes (sets valid_to=now) when confidence falls below min_confidence. Closure records closed_reason="decay" in properties. Skips nodes confirmed within max_age_hours window.
gotchas: NodeFilter lacks direct valid_to=None criterion; code manually skips closed nodes in loop. Upsert semantics via persistence.save_node() mean repeated calls are safe. Comment at line 145 notes the filter limitation.
